corpus.title: Polygondwanaland
corpus.motto: King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard's 2017 polymetric concept album, annotated for structural analysis
corpus.text: *Polygondwanaland* is the twelfth studio album by Australian psychedelic rock band King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, released in November 2017. The album makes extensive use of polymetric structures, with several metric patterns coexisting and interacting throughout, making it a rich corpus for the study of musical structure, rhythm and meter. This annotated database was built as part of the PhD work of Mathys Daniel (IRMA, University of Strasbourg / LIP6, Sorbonne University), and is discussed in Daniel, Lascabettes, Andreatta & Bloch, *Musical Pattern Discovery at Regular Time Intervals Through Mathematical Morphology: An Application to Polymetric Structure Analysis*, SMC 2026 ([HAL hal-05710365](https://hal.science/hal-05710365)).
corpus.availability: All 10 tracks of the album are provided with MP3 audio, MIDI (derived from an 8-bit cover by 8-bit Escapades), MusicXML symbolic scores, and Dezrann (.dez) structural annotations combining algorithmic and manual analysis.
